key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1434
name: draw_blitter_polygon_edges
description: Walks a list of paired coordinate records, computing each edge's horizontal and vertical steps and an error accumulator, and programs the blitter's line registers for every edge, waiting for the blitter to go idle before each write. Subroutines emit the span rows for the polygon.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:152C
name: emit_blitter_span_rows
description: Loops over a per-row table of stored offsets, writing each row's destination pointer and size into the blitter registers and waiting for the blitter to be idle before every write. An alternate path first applies a row count and modulo update taken from the caller's record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:15DC
name: emit_blitter_offset_rows
description: Calls a subroutine to compute a starting offset, then programs the blitter's destination pointer and size registers for each row in a group, stepping the source offset by the stored row increment until the row counter runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1628
name: emit_blitter_row_run
description: Iterates over a run count, programming the blitter's pointer and size registers for each row and advancing the offset by the stored stride, then returns to its caller once the run is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:168E
name: compute_bitplane_byte_offset
description: Computes the byte offset of a position within a bitplane. It takes the difference between two stored row coordinates, then either indexes a row-offset table or multiplies by the row stride, and adds a column byte offset derived from the horizontal difference divided by eight.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:16AA
name: compute_row_address_offset
description: Multiplies the low word of its input by the stored row stride and adds the column byte offset from a horizontal coordinate difference divided by eight, returning the combined 32-bit address offset.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:16C0
name: stub_flag_table_check
description: Reads a byte from a global table at an index and tests it for zero and for a sign bit. Both branches return without any action, so the decompiled body has no effect beyond returning.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:16F0
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Returns straight away with no operations; the decompiled body contains nothing beyond the return, so the routine has no observable effect.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:170A
name: stub_empty_routine_return
description: Returns immediately with no operations; the decompiled body contains nothing beyond the return, so the routine has no observable effect.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1716
name: build_shifted_mask_rows
description: Builds blitter source and mask rows. It reads either per-row records or fixed bit masks, shifts each 16-bit source word by a computed amount, stores each shifted word twice, zero-fills the rest of the row, and writes the inverted combined mask alongside it.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:178C
name: rotate_source_rows_with_mask
description: Processes a set of rows by rotating each 16-bit source word by a shift count held in a register, storing each rotated word twice, zero-filling the remaining columns, and writing the inverted OR of the row's bits as the mask word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:17BE
name: expand_alternating_bit_masks
description: Expands the bits of two flag bytes into per-row 32-bit words using alternating one-and-zero bit patterns, one table per byte. When the row's sign flag is set it swaps the two pattern words, then stores the final pair of 32-bit words.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:17D0
name: expand_flagged_pattern_masks
description: Expands the bits of two flag bytes into per-row 32-bit words using alternating bit patterns. Flag bits choose between pattern inversion and a fixed fill, the result is written as one table per byte, and the final pattern pair is stored into two fixed slots of the caller's record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:185A
name: expand_bit_pattern_columns
description: Loops over a column count, shifting a bit register and storing one of two pattern words into each of two tables depending on the low bit. It then stores the final pattern pair into two fixed slots of the caller's record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:185E
name: expand_byte_bits_into_tables
description: Loops over a fixed number of columns, taking one bit at a time from a byte and storing either zero or a pattern word into each of two tables. It finishes by storing the last pattern pair into two fixed slots.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1892
name: setup_bitmap_header_fields
description: Reads a bitmap record and stores its key fields: the plane-data pointer, a flag byte, a bit depth, the row width in bytes after rounding up to whole 16-pixel words, and the padding modulo. It then dispatches on a mode value, and the mode-zero path scales the width and height before computing draw offsets.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:18BC
name: load_relative_bitmap_header
description: Locates a bitmap record through a relative pointer and stores its plane-data pointer, flag byte, bit depth, row width in bytes after rounding to whole 16-pixel words, and padding modulo. It then dispatches on a mode value, and the mode-zero and mode-one paths scale dimensions and compute draw offsets before a shared exit.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1914
name: store_scaled_draw_rectangle
description: Scales the requested width and height by a stored factor, returning failure when a scaled dimension becomes zero. Otherwise it saves the rectangle corner and size into the state block, computes a centred origin from half the width, and calls two subroutines to finish setup.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1952
name: store_centered_draw_rectangle
description: Saves a rectangle's corner and size into the state block without scaling, computes a centred origin from half the width and a row-count offset, calls two subroutines, and returns success unless a bail-out flag is set.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:19AA
name: store_flagged_draw_rectangle
description: Optionally calls a subroutine to fetch coordinates when one state flag is set. When a second flag is clear, it stores the mode byte and duplicates the coordinate pair into the state block with a zero offset, calls two subroutines, and returns success.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:19D4
name: compute_scaled_blit_rectangle
description: Derives an output rectangle from the requested width and height: it keeps them, scales one side to preserve the aspect ratio of the other, or uses the source extents. Negative sizes are flipped with an origin shift, the flip bits are recorded, and the rectangle is saved before subroutines finish setup.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A2E
name: store_flip_normalized_rectangle
description: Scales one dimension by a ratio of two inputs when a flag bit selects it, converts negative width or height to positive values while recording a flip bit and shifting the origin, and returns early when the flip bits do not match the caller's mask. Otherwise it stores the rectangle and calls two subroutines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A3C
name: store_ratio_flipped_rectangle
description: Scales the height from the width ratio when a flag bit is set, converts negative sizes to positive while recording flip bits and moving the origin, and returns early when the flip bits do not match the caller's mask. Otherwise it stores the rectangle and calls two subroutines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A7E
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero with no operations; the decompiled body is a bare return of a zero value, so the routine has no observable effect beyond that result.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A82
name: build_deduplicated_row_offsets
description: Fills an offset table from a source record, either adding a base pointer to each relative entry or copying entries directly when a flag bit is set. It then walks the table, giving each distinct nonzero value a running stride-based slot and marking later duplicates as reused, and saves the final slot value and a count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AC0
name: assign_unique_row_slots
description: Adds a base value to each nonzero entry of a source table into a destination table. It then walks the destination assigning a running slot value to each distinct entry and marking duplicates with a sentinel, storing the final slot value and remaining count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AE4
name: mark_matching_row_slots
description: Writes the current value and slot into the table, scans the rest of the table marking later entries equal to that value as reused, then advances the running slot and moves on to the next distinct value until the table ends, storing the final slot and count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AF0
name: mark_duplicate_row_entries
description: Scans the remainder of a table for entries equal to the current value, storing the running slot into each matching position and marking those entries reused. It advances the slot after each pass and stores the final slot and remaining count when the table ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B18
name: clip_rectangle_to_window
description: Tests a rectangle against a clip box held in the state record and returns zero when it lies entirely outside. Otherwise it stores how far the rectangle overhangs each of the four edges, reduces the remaining width and height by those amounts, and returns zero if nothing visible remains.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B8A
name: stub_return_zero_status
description: Returns zero immediately with no other operations; the decompiled body is only a return of zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B8E
name: compute_scanline_step_table
description: Derives per-line fixed-point stepping values from the width and height ratios and stores them in the state record. It computes a starting address from a row offset table, then fills a per-row table with shifted word offsets and row modulo values for each line of the drawn region.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1BCE
name: fill_bitplane_shift_table
description: Computes horizontal and vertical step increments from the ratio of requested to source sizes, then loops over the rows writing each row's shift nibble and word offset into a table, accumulating the step as it goes.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1BF0
name: fill_scanline_step_offsets
description: Computes the starting address and row modulo from the clipped rectangle, then fills a per-row table of shifted word offsets and shift values from an accumulated step. It also works out the leftover partial-word shift counts used for the first and last blit words.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1C54
name: compute_blit_word_split
description: Stores the base address and modulo for the blit, fills per-row shift words from an accumulated step, and splits the row width into whole 16-bit words plus a leftover partial word. It saves the word count and the first and last word masks in the state record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1C98
name: accumulate_and_fill_word_offsets
description: Accumulates a horizontal step over a fixed number of columns, writes each row's shifted word offset and shift value into a table, splits the row width into whole words and a partial-word remainder, then calls a subroutine before continuing with the per-row loop.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1CA6
name: fill_inverted_mask_word_offsets
description: Writes per-row word offsets like its neighbours, but stores the complement of each shifted word ANDed with a stored mask so the result acts as a clipping mask. It splits the row width into whole words and a partial remainder, then calls a subroutine before its per-row loop.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1CE0
name: pack_row_pixel_bits
description: Splits the row width into whole 16-bit words and a partial remainder, then for each row gathers one bit per pixel from the source data and packs them into words stored in the row buffer. Each packed row is handed on through subroutines after the blitter-busy wait.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1D64
name: pack_source_rows_into_words
description: Loops over rows and columns, taking a single bit from each source byte at a computed offset and shifting it into a running 16-bit word. It stores the whole words of each row, then the partial remainder word, and loops until every row is written.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1DF0
name: advance_and_pack_rows
description: Advances a row pointer by a stored stride using an accumulator, then packs the next row's bits into words with the same gather-and-shift loop as its neighbour. It returns once the row count runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1DF8
name: copy_or_zero_fill_rows
description: Walks each row of the table, copying stored words from a source buffer into the destination when a flag bit is set and writing zero words for the remaining columns. When the source is empty it zero-fills the row instead, and it returns when all rows are written.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E34
name: merge_masked_row_segments
description: ORs source words into a row buffer, then walks a segment table merging each segment into the destination. Full-width segments are ORed in, partial segments are combined with an AND-NOT mask, and empty segments clear the masked bits.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E88
name: apply_mask_to_row_segments
description: Walks the row segment table, ORing source words into the destination for full-width segments and applying an AND-NOT with the mask for partial segments. Empty segments clear the masked bits, and the routine ends once all rows are processed.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E96
name: clear_then_merge_row_segments
description: Clears the destination bits covered by the mask, then walks the segment table merging source words into each row. Full-width segments are ORed in and partial segments are combined with an AND-NOT mask.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EA6
name: merge_long_row_segments
description: Walks the segment table for each row using 32-bit words, ORing source longs into the destination for full-width segments and combining them with an AND-NOT mask for partial segments. Empty segments clear the destination longs.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1ED2
name: or_source_into_long_segments
description: ORs source longs into the row buffer, then walks the segment table using 32-bit words. Full-width segments are ORed in, partial segments are combined with an AND-NOT mask, and empty segments clear the masked longs.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EE0
name: apply_mask_to_long_segments
description: Walks the long-word segment table for each row, applying an AND-NOT with the mask to empty and partial segments and ORing source longs into full-width segments, and finishes when every row is processed.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EF0
name: copy_or_zero_word_segments
description: Copies source words into each row segment from the segment table, writing zero words for empty segments and combining partial segments with a mask. It stops once all rows are written.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F18
name: clear_then_copy_row_segments
description: Zeroes each row first, then copies source words into the destination for every segment in the table, stopping when the row count runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F24
name: copy_or_zero_long_segments
description: Walks the segment table for each row using 32-bit words, copying source longs into the destination for segments with data and writing zero longs for empty segments. It continues until every row has been written.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F40
name: zero_row_then_copy_words
description: Zeroes one row of words, then copies source words into the row for each segment in the table, zero-filling any span with no source, until the segment count runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F4C
name: build_row_pointer_table
description: Computes a starting byte offset from clipped source coordinates and the row size, then fills a table of per-row pointers relative to a base. When a flag bit is set it stores pointer differences instead, and a second pass prepares the row offsets for the blit.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F90
name: fill_row_pointer_table_masked
description: Computes the same starting offset from a shared multiplier and row size, then fills the per-row pointer table. It stores either a pointer difference or a base-relative value depending on a flag bit, and runs the row loop to completion.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1FEE
name: run_masked_blit_pass
description: Builds per-row pointer tables from the source and mask data, computes the first-word shift and starting row from the clipped rectangle, then drives the pass by waiting for the blitter and calling a sequence of row subroutines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:20D0
name: blit_shifted_masked_words
description: Copies rows of source words into the destination after shifting each word by a bit count. It clears the destination bits covered by the mask first, then ORs in the shifted source, and handles bits that spill into the next column separately.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2114
name: clear_shifted_mask_rows
description: Clears destination bits in each row by ANDing with the complement of the shifted source words, handling the spill word at the end of each row. It walks the row pointer table and stops when every row has been processed.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:212A
name: clear_shifted_rows_pointer_check
description: Clears destination bits from shifted source words like its neighbour, and additionally compares each row's source pointer against the previous one, skipping a row when the pointers match. It stops once all rows are done.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2158
name: or_shifted_source_rows
description: Ors shifted source words into the destination row by row, left-shifting each word by a bit count and handling the spill word at the end of each row. It walks the row pointer table and returns once every row is done.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:216C
name: or_shifted_rows_pointer_check
description: Ors shifted source words into the destination like its neighbour, with a stacked row-count argument. It compares each row's source pointer against a reference pointer and takes a separate path for rows whose pointers match.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:219E
name: clear_right_shifted_mask_rows
description: Clears destination bits by ANDing with the complement of source words shifted right by a count, with separate handling for the spill word. It picks between a clear path and an OR path for each row depending on pointer comparisons.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:21E8
name: clear_right_shifted_rows_stacked
description: Clears destination bits from right-shifted source words row by row, with a stacked row-count argument and a shared row pointer table. It handles the spill word at the end of each row and returns when all rows are processed.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2228
name: clear_right_shifted_complement_rows
description: Clears destination bits in each row by ANDing with the complement of the source words shifted right by a count, handling the spill word at the end of each row. It walks the row pointer table and returns when the row count reaches zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2242
name: clear_right_shifted_rows_checked
description: Clears destination bits with the complement of right-shifted source words row by row, using a stacked row-count argument. It compares each row's source pointer with a reference pointer to decide whether to continue the current row or start a new one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:226E
name: or_right_shifted_source_rows
description: ORs right-shifted source words into the destination row by row, handling the spill word at the end of each row. It walks the row pointer table and returns when the row count reaches zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2286
name: or_right_shifted_rows_checked

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a2]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a2].adf:libs/vector.library:0:274E

description: Calls three subroutines in turn and returns zero. The routine has no logic of its own beyond those three calls.

description: Calls three subroutines in turn and returns zero, with no logic of its own beyond the three calls.
